payload.report_excerpt: Low-rank update matrices of rank eight match full fine-tuning on the reported suite while training 0.1% of the parameters [Sable, 2019].
payload.source_excerpt: We insert small bottleneck adapter layers between transformer sublayers and train only the adapters, reaching within 0.4 points of full fine-tuning while training 3.6% of parameters. We do not study low-rank reparameterisation of the existing weight matrices.
